about: Opens a short note beside its trigger on a press, and closes it on a second press, Escape or a press outside. It looks like a tooltip and opens like a popover, so it works on a touch screen and can contain a link. The trigger keeps focus, and a screen reader hears the note as it opens.

definition.label: Chargeback
definition.tip: A payment the cardholder's bank takes back after a dispute.

fees.about: Three fees in a data list, each with a note beside its name. Each note is a toggle tip of its own, and the buttons take their size and look from one `ButtonPropsProvider`.

conversion.label: Currency conversion
conversion.tip: Charged on a payout in another currency.

payout.label: Payout fee
payout.tip: Charged once for each payout to your bank.

processing.label: Processing fee
processing.tip: Charged by the card network on every payment.

fees.title: Fees

placement.about: The note on each side of its trigger, set by the machine's `positioning.placement`. The machine flips a note that would cross the edge of the window to the opposite side.
placement.title: Placement

terms.about: A note with a link. Tab from the trigger moves into the note, so the link is reachable from the keyboard, and Tab out of the note closes it.
terms.label: Returned payouts
terms.tip: A returned payout is raised again after three working days.
terms.title: Note with a link

title: Toggle tip

variant.about: Every look at every size. Press a trigger to open its note. The size sets the note's padding and text.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
